name: Śrī Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī
replace: **Lalitā Sakhī** (*Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā* 160; *Abhidhāna*). The record's English text gave Viśākhā, and Lalitā according to Dhyānacandra Gosvāmī.
**Viśākhā Sakhī** (*Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā* 160). The *Abhidhāna* gives Lalitā, and so does Dhyānacandra Gosvāmī, it is said; the *Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā* is followed here (see his «Gaṇoddeśa»).
